title: It's ok
text: I got my first subscription box. I was expecting to have different things to try for the first box but ended up receiving some duplicate items.  It would've been nice to have bones and hooves instead of too many bully sicks like or two pig skins. I buy a large bag of bully sticks (50+) and cow ears (20+) so this was a bit disappointing.  My dogs tried pig skins.  They seemed to like it but their tummy wasn't so happy.  It maybe too much for them. I wish we were able to customize what we want to get for each month.  Human meal delivery service let me pick the menu why can I pick for dog? For what I got for $29.99+tax is too pricey. I'll reconsider to order them again when they start to have an option to customize the box.
label: neutral
